title: listings.search_documents
description: Keyed batch read of indexable listing documents — the pull half of the search seam (the listing.* events carry identity, the document is fetched here). Answers {key: {title, description, language, category_id, owner_id, price, currency, price_base, lat, lon, geohash, location_id, location_label, status, moderation_status, features_search, features_title, images, published_at, updated_at}}; Decimals are strings and datetimes ISO 8601. A key with no listing (unknown or soft-deleted) is absent from the answer.

keys.description: Listing primary keys, as strings or integers.
